study: Secondary transparent two-bit distillation of the frozen w3 b1 seed-11 static encoder; no rescue of the negative barrier-inclusive transfer result.
population: Archived independent L20 parents only. Existing training and validation cohorts have historical aggregate results, including prior temperature comparisons. This is a prospective compressor rule/margin, not blind new data. Never access beta 6 or test rows.
fit: Cold training partition only, 32 periodic origins per parent from RNG [726101,9]. Use first 7680 parents to grow one maximum-depth-5 tree by greedy unsmoothed soft-teacher cross-entropy decrease; minimum 256 origin records per child. Candidate depths 1 through 5 are nested prunings. Only the other 2560 training parents calibrate leaf distributions for each pruning and each control, by adding 0.5 effective examples per teacher label. Deterministic argmax (lower label wins ties). Never read shell pixels in fitting or calibration.
features: z,y,x, x-fastest. c- is (−1,−1,−1), c+ is (+1,+1,+1); split on A or B indicators per corner, three inward nearest neighbor vacancy counts k-,k+, difference k- minus k+, whole-block signed vacancy moment sum_vacant(z+y+x) in centered coordinates, and the number of occupied sites among the block center's six nearest neighbors. The three inward neighbors are the entire coordination support inside the block at a corner; no exterior halo. Coordinates, labels and carrier are fixed in the teacher's original orientation, no image alignment. Controls: calibrated 2 A bits, 9 exact ordered corner states, and 0..54 vacancy/particle nearest-neighbor interface area in the entire block (individually calibrated); not new shell critics.
deployment: compress(ternary_blocks, rules_dict, selected_depth) emits a uint8 array with four hard labels per byte, first label in bits 0..1, zero tail padding. unpack_labels(payload, n) recovers the n integer labels (not the original blocks). Neither needs teacher weights or exterior pixels. packets-XX.npz includes the actual packed_hard_symbols[repeat,method,byte_of_native_validation_parent_order] and the label next to its class probabilities is explicit in rules.json. If the public lock selects no rule, no tree is endorsed for deployment.
validation: All 2048 native validation parents per beta in canonical partition order, 128 random periodic origins/parent with replacement from l20_pairs.partition(index)'s validation anchor stream, matching all methods pointwise. First six repeat banks reproduce the historical cold validation receipt. Predict at each origin, then integrate probabilities or take argmax at that origin, never average a parent before encoding. Fixed oriented 150-site 5x5 face patches at radius 3, original encoder, original shell critic, original log-mean-exp over 128 distinct parent shells including the positive. Sixteen disjoint, fixed packets of 128 parents; no cross-packet negative mixing. Exact expected categorical (stochastic) log bound and deterministic hard-label log bound, in nats/origin. Off-diagonal shuffle is the exact mean over 127 wrong positives, not an assumed zero score.
calibration: Require original cold six-repeat expected-label score within 2e-6 nats, independent direct reference evaluate agreement within 2e-6, positive cold and warm teacher raw and teacher-minus-offdiagonal lower 95% bounds for hard and stochastic encodings, and exact constant-code diagonal/shuffle equality plus zero-logit chance score. Uniform-code bound is generally negative, not zero. At beta=0 report teacher diagonal-minus-shuffle specificity (equivalence if 95% interval lies inside ±0.01 nats); this is a descriptive separate diagnostic, not a warm selection rule.
selection: Primary deployment output is the deterministic hard code. Corners in the primary contrast always means the calibrated exact ordered ternary corner pair (not chosen on validation); the two A-bit baseline is reported separately. Require positive cold teacher-minus-corners lower 95% bound and calibrated reference. Choose the shallowest depth whose cold validation packet-mean hard-label agreement with teacher argmax is >=0.55, tree-minus-corners >=0.005 nats/origin, and (tree-corners)-0.5*(teacher-corners) >=0. These are selection point criteria, not post-selection evidence. No eligible tree is a permitted outcome; then no rule prediction is tested at warm.
transfer: Public git freeze of code, design, calibrated readable rules, cold results, packet evidence and lock before archive access. Never train or select at warm. Designated beta=2.711111111111 validation: predeclare positive teacher-minus-exact-corners, at least 0.005 extra nats/origin from the selected hard tree versus exact corners, and at least half the hard teacher-minus-exact-corners gain. Assess paired linear contrasts, not ratios. Support if all respective lower 95% bounds clear 0, 0.005, 0. If reference calibration fails or teacher-minus-corners is not demonstrably positive, call unresolved. Otherwise an upper bound below a predicted margin excludes it; else unresolved. No switching comparator or selecting another tree. Beta=0 validation is specificity only.
uncertainty: All paired t intervals operate on the same 16 disjoint 128-parent packet means, after averaging repeated origins within packet; 15 df. Pointwise, conditional on the frozen calibration/fit. Packet delete-one jackknife intervals for entropy/rate. Do not treat sites or anchor repeats as independent. Report symbol masses, agreement with hard teacher, expected teacher posterior KL to fitted soft surrogate, and H(output), H(output|V), empirical I(V;output) from frequencies. Hard code uses exactly 2 fixed-width stored bits per origin, H(output)<=2 is its marginal Shannon rate, not measured compressibility of a correlated lattice field. The soft posterior is not a two-bit vector payload: transmit a single categorical draw to realize that channel.
scope: Scores are for a specific label-oriented frozen critic. Teacher-derived relabeling is fair across controls but is not independent critic optimization or an MI difference or a unique thermodynamic mechanism. A failed prediction neither erases the earlier signal nor proves absence of other transparent rules. A successful one is a transferable local surrogate, not a rescue of the barrier model.
transfer_command: After publishing cold-lock.json and its artifacts: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 ~/.local/share/venvs/rsmi-l20-f898730/bin/python examples/glass_autoresearch/transparent.py transfer --data ~/datasets/lattice-glass/l20-16384-v1 --lock-commit <public-cold-commit>
resources: One CPU worker; BLAS/OMP=1, no GPU, no scratch bank. Only selected rows of one compressed archive at a time. Fit ~82 MB of selected cold parent species, plus streaming origin and model work arrays; budget 1 GiB RAM. Compact repeated-origin x disjoint-packet summaries, not patches or per-site logits, are published. No simulator or remote acquisition.
